'''Rordan's Galactic Exotic Art''' was a business located in [[Verena City]]. It was a clean, one-story building with two large display windows and was in good repair. It was run by [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] agent [[Bren-Nevin Rordan]].<ref name="DS" />
